messages:
sreina: FYI partner portal just rejected the PO for NovaEdge — says 'SKU split across multiple items' and won't accept combined bundle. Portal error: SKU_SPLIT_422. Link: https://portal.marketplace.example/po/5234
marketplace-bot: PO 5234 rejected: SKU_SPLIT_422 — see docs https://docs.marketplace/dev/po-errors
dave: Ugh. This is the bundle we sent to accommodate the reseller. Can we push a patched PO? @jordan can finance supply EIN + tax info so portal accepts?
jordan: I can provide the EIN but legal needs the signed MSA before we can update billing entity. Sophie, any update on the redline?
sophie: Legal asked partner to remove clause 7.4 carveout. Partner returned countersigned with track changes but their signatory name doesn't match the org record. I just sent a Docusign request with corrected signer details — ETA ~24h.
dave: Ok — temporary workaround: split the bundle into separate SKU lines to satisfy the portal validation. @sreina can you ask partner to accept amended PO? I'll queue re-upload if they agree.
marketplace-bot: To re-upload use:
```
curl -X POST "https://portal.marketplace.example/api/v1/po/upload" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@po5234_split.xml"
```
sreina: Pinged partner legal and reseller ops. Partner prefers not to split SKUs but said they'll confirm on the signatory fix within a few hours. If they decline split, we'll need manual intake by ops (costly). Will update thread when Docusign completes :eyes:
dave: Thanks — if Docusign slips, I’ll open an ops manual-ingest ticket and loop in @eng-ops. For now marking this as high priority on the deal desk.
